records.missingActualOperator: Read SH energy-renewables source evaluates energy sustainability, while source ester-mechanism clause demands an ester-synthesis mechanism. Current P directly explains transesterification/cleavage and qualitative system boundaries but does not supply the full required mechanism; no equally precise SH transesterification/source-ester-cleavage operator has been established here. Named biodiesel absence alone is not the reason.

records.hold: Read SLfat/TG/ester and alkanol-solubility cells demand those specific substances/force explanations; the actual soap P justifies amphiphile interfacial organisation and dispersion, not TG cleavage or enumerating all force types. Need a whole appropriate interfacial/structure-property model source clause; not a claim that only an explicit Micelle label could suffice.
records.scientificOverlap: Whole P uses actual supplied soap structure to justify orientation at air/water and oil/water interfaces, normal micelles, dispersion/surface-tension data and fresh reversed phase geometry without claiming inverse-emulsion stability.
records.boundary: Models and provided data only; no actual surface-tension experiment, fat cleavage, soap synthesis or proof that all listed intermolecular-force types were independently identified.
